name: RF5CFX
description: Ricoh RF5C164 8-bit sign-magnitude PCM lo-fi processor with 4-32.55 kHz clock, random S&H clock jitter, and 4 output stages.

params.name: Model
params.explanation: Sega CD hardware output stage (Model 1 stage, Model 2 dark stage, Portable crisp stage, Raw 8-bit RF5C164 tap).

params.name: Rate
params.explanation: Ricoh RF5C164 PCM clock rate (4..33 kHz; 33 = max 32.55 kHz).

params.name: Bits
params.explanation: 8-bit sign-magnitude PCM grit (0 = clean 16-bit CD-DA, 55 = authentic 8-bit RF5C164, 100 = crunchy 4.5-bit).

params.name: ClkJit
params.explanation: Random S&H RF5C164 clock jitter & drift (0 = crystal-locked, 100 = unstable clock).

params.name: Tone
params.explanation: Analog reconstruction low-pass filter trim (0 = dark, 100 = bright).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Master output level (80 is unity gain).
